newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal cuts repo rate after Spain.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal cuts repo rate after Spain.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it cut its key money market repo rate by 15 basis points to 7.10 percent effective on Friday at the start of a new 10-day commercial bank reserve period.

The Portuguese bond market had expected a cut in the repo rate of between 25 and 50 basis points after the Bank of Spain cuts its key money market interest rate earlier by 50 basis points to 6.75 percent.
But some Portuguese analysts had warned the Bank of Portugal could delay a cut in the repo rate until it was confident that inflation was on a firm downward path after creeping up over the summer.
Portuguese and Spanish bonds have surged recently on optimism that the two countries would qualify to join a single European currency in 1999.
